name: Freya HUD
author: Freya
description: The Freya cockpit HUD: a glass player card (hull / shield / energy) with the 12-slot action hotbar, plus a bottom-left discipline card (combat / trade / explore levels + XP). Visibility-gated on game state -- shown in space, cards-only in station, hidden on login / char-select. Depends on hide-ui to suppress the stock widgets that would otherwise show through the glass.
